constraints: charSet may be given as a standard character-set name or alias (e.g. "ISO-8859-1", "UTF-8") or as a numeric identifier (longint); see CONVERT FROM TEXT for the supported set.
If charSet designates a Unicode encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16, or UTF-32) and the BLOB begins with a Byte Order Mark, the BOM is detected and honored during conversion.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Converts the raw bytes of a BLOB, interpreted as text in the given character set, into a 4D Text value (UTF-16).
